input.title: Validate registration form
input.description: Check registration using an email address.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate email addresses must be rejected.

assumptions.description: A browser-accessible registration form and an isolated test environment are available.
Otherwise valid registration data and an unused email address are available; any additional mandatory fields are identified before testing.
An existing account fixture and a reviewable way to determine registration success, account creation, and changes to that fixture are available.

criteria.explanation: The form must require an email. Exact validation wording and presentation are unspecified but do not prevent conceptual verification.

negativeTests.reason: Submission without an email is covered.

boundaryTests.reason: Clearing a populated email field to empty covers the required-field boundary.

criteria.explanation: An email already associated with an account must be rejected. Email normalization and comparison rules are unspecified.

negativeTests.reason: Attempting to reuse an existing email with different registration details covers forbidden duplicate registration.

boundaryTests.reason: No case, whitespace, aliasing, or other email-equivalence boundaries are defined.

criteria.explanation: Successful registration with valid data has clear conceptual intent. Valid fixtures and an observable success outcome are needed; exact success text and destination are unspecified.

negativeTests.reason: A registration missing the required email must not produce a successful registration.

boundaryTests.reason: No limits or additional boundaries for valid registration data are supplied.

scenarios.title: A supplied email satisfies the required-field check
preconditions: An unused valid email and otherwise valid registration data are available.

steps.instruction: Complete registration with the available valid data, including the email.

steps.expectedOutcome: Email-required validation does not block submission.

assertions.description: A populated valid email satisfies the email-required condition.

scenarios.title: Reject submission with email omitted
preconditions: All other mandatory fields can be completed with valid data.

steps.instruction: Complete the other mandatory fields while leaving email empty.
steps.expectedOutcome: Email is absent and other required data is supplied.
Registration is blocked because email is required.

assertions.description: Registration cannot succeed without an email.

scenarios.title: Required validation applies after email is cleared
preconditions: The registration form is open with otherwise valid data.

steps.instruction: Enter a valid email, then remove its entire contents.
steps.expectedOutcome: The email field changes from populated to empty.

assertions.description: Previously entering an email does not allow an empty email to pass required validation.

scenarios.title: Reject an email already registered
preconditions: An existing account's email is known.

steps.instruction: Complete otherwise valid registration data using the existing account's email exactly as stored.
steps.expectedOutcome: The submission contains a known duplicate email.
The application rejects the duplicate email.

assertions.description: The duplicate email is rejected and no additional account is created for it.

scenarios.title: Different registration details do not bypass duplicate rejection
preconditions: An existing account fixture is available.
Otherwise valid registration details differing from that account are available.

steps.instruction: Complete registration using the existing email and different values for the other available registration details.
steps.expectedOutcome: The email remains an exact duplicate despite the different details.

steps.instruction: Submit registration and inspect the account outcome.
steps.expectedOutcome: The duplicate registration is rejected without creating an additional account or replacing the existing account's details.

assertions.description: Changing other registration details does not permit registration with an existing email.

scenarios.title: Complete registration with valid data
preconditions: A complete valid registration fixture with an unused email is available.
The registration success outcome can be observed.

steps.instruction: Complete all mandatory registration fields with valid data.
steps.expectedOutcome: The form contains a complete valid registration.
The outcome confirms successful registration of the new account.

assertions.description: Valid registration creates the intended account and produces an observable success outcome; exact wording and destination remain unspecified.

scenarios.title: An incomplete registration does not report success
preconditions: Otherwise valid registration data is available.

steps.instruction: Complete the registration data while omitting the required email.
Attempt submission and review the registration outcome.
steps.expectedOutcome: Registration is blocked and no successful account creation is reported.

assertions.description: A submission missing the required email does not create an account or produce a successful registration outcome.

ticket.title: Validate registration form
ticket.description: Check registration using an email address.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Duplicate email addresses must be rejected.
